acceptance_criteria: The exact assigned medoid fingerprint is bound to the same partition, cluster version, distance pack and scale pack.
Recorded distance, recomputed distance and weighted component total all equal 0.1.
The outlier classification is reproducible against the frozen p90 threshold of 0.05.
The LONG_PERSISTENCE trigger is reconciled between pre-window trigger history and the post-trigger candidate fingerprint without a trigger-rule change.
The candidate has a unique dedup key, a unique exact window and no overlapping candidate.
No second machine replay, canonical append, promotion, selector mutation, release mutation, threshold change or model change occurred.
decision.closure_basis: All CORR2 structural-comparison deferral criteria are closed by preserved pilot evidence: exact assigned-medoid exposure, deterministic component-level distance reconciliation, explicit persistence-scope reconciliation, and explicit duplicate, overlap and comparison-availability status.
decision.notes: The exact assigned medoid and same-partition structural comparison are available. Recorded distance, recomputed distance and weighted component total all equal 0.1, with the full contribution arising from state_path. The outlier classification is consistent with the frozen 0.05 threshold. LONG_PERSISTENCE is reconciled as a four-record pre-window trigger followed by a one-record post-trigger candidate fingerprint. The candidate has a unique dedup key, a unique exact window and no overlapping candidate.
